text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Trainer. How about basking in the sun... or just 
taking a short break together?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This spot is perfect for resting. Even when the sun 
is high, it’s not too hot, just nice and warm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! S-sorry! ...Ehehe. Well, it just means this 
place is so nice you’d get drowsy.
